check_name: Wait records only for completed visits
details: No-show, cancelled and future scheduled appointments should not have completed-visit wait records.
Each completed appointment must have the defined eight-stage flow.
Stage end must not precede stage start and durations must be non-negative.
A later operational stage cannot start before the prior stage ends.
All patient-experience scores must be between 1 and 5.
NO_SHOW records must reference appointments with No-Show status.
Cancellation must occur before the appointment and match Cancelled status.
Staffing hour measures cannot be negative.
Future appointments must remain Scheduled to prevent target leakage.
